Ticket:
Lab orders getting rejected due to missing diagnosis codes

We are getting so tired of lab orders getting rejected because the system isn't making it clear where to attach the required ICD-10 diagnosis codes. Every time we try to submit an electronic lab order to our reference lab, it bounces back with an error. Can someone please explain how to fix this layout issue?

  "draft": "Hi there,
